mutations.name: the resolver polls every PR it is handed
kills: the gh PR resolver recheck intervals an open PR checked within the interval is not asked again

mutations.name: a backfill PR waits for the closed interval
kills: the gh PR resolver recheck intervals a checked merged PR missing commit times is asked inside the closed interval

mutations.name: a closed PR waits only the open interval
kills: the gh PR resolver recheck intervals a closed PR is re-checked after the interval
